name: AECi — Algolia sync failed (daily cron)
message:
The incremental Algolia sync reported a failed entity push (AECI-139, daily 03:00 UTC cron / post-promote hook). The affected index is stale until the next successful run, with no page-level symptom. `outcome:failed` is per entity — pivot the 'AECi Phase 3 — Search' dashboard by `entity` (products/vendors/integrations) to see which.

Note: this monitor fires only on an actual failed push and deliberately does NOT use notify_no_data — `outcome:failed` is absent on a healthy run, so no-data here would be a constant false alarm. Cron liveness ('did the 03:00 UTC sync run at all?') is the companion monitor 'AECi — Algolia sync not running', which watches the `outcome:ok` series that does report every healthy run.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#algolia-sync-failed
